map.看涨买方损益 = max(S_T−K,0)−权利金，盈亏平衡点 = K+权利金，: Call buyer payoff = max(S_T - K, 0) - premium, the break-even point = K + premium, the maximum loss is the premium and the maximum profit is theoretically unlimited; puts and sellers follow symmetric rules. ...
map.看涨买方须涨过 K+权利金才回本，这是常被忽略的成本: The call buyer must rise above K + premium to break even, a frequently overlooked cost
map.买方一定比卖方好？: Is the buyer always better off?
map.不一定；买方亏有限但胜率常低，卖方胜率高但尾部风险大，按观点与资金匹配。: Not necessarily; the buyer's loss is limited but the win rate is often low, while the seller has a high win rate but large tail risk, so match the position to your view and capital.
map.盈亏平衡点含权利金吗？: Does the break-even point include the premium?
map.含。看涨买方须涨过 K+权利金才回本，这是常被忽略的成本。: Yes. The call buyer must rise above K + premium to break even, which is a frequently overlooked cost.
